org.portico.utils.messaging

Annotation Type MessageHandler


  • @Documented
 @Target(value=TYPE)
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface MessageHandler
    This annotation outlines the configuration data needed for a message handler. All valid message handlers should declare this annotation and implement the IMessageHandler interface.

    • Required Element Summary

      Required Elements 
      Modifier and Type Required Element and Description
      Class<? extends PorticoMessage> messages
      The classes of all the PorticoMessage children the handler wants to handle
      String[] sinks
      The name of the sink (or sinks) this handler expects to be deployed into.

    • Optional Element Summary

      Optional Elements 
      Modifier and Type Optional Element and Description
      boolean augmentable
      Is this handler happy to be extended into a chain (defaults to true)
      MessageSink.Global global
      The global message sink the handler should be added to.
      String[] keywords
      List of tags that a handler can use to specify what it requires from components.
      String[] modules
      The names of the modules that this handler belongs to.
      String name
      The name of the component.
      int priority
      If handler is augmented, where should it fall in the chain?

    • Element Detail

      • sinks

        public abstract String[] sinks
        The name of the sink (or sinks) this handler expects to be deployed into. For general Portico use this will be either "incoming" or "outgiong".

      • messages

        public abstract Class<? extends PorticoMessage> messages
        The classes of all the PorticoMessage children the handler wants to handle

      • name

        public abstract String name
        The name of the component. If no name is provided, the string "" will be used. If the annotation is not provided, the setName() method for the handler will never actually be called (so the default will be whatever the handler uses). In the provided handler implementation (which can be used as a base for all other handlers), this defaults to the name of the class (without the package prefix).
        Default:
        "<unknown>"

      • modules

        public abstract String[] modules
        The names of the modules that this handler belongs to. A module is just a name that can be used to group handlers together so they can be managed as a single entity.
        Default:
        ""

      • keywords

        public abstract String[] keywords
        List of tags that a handler can use to specify what it requires from components. When applying a module to set of handlers, a group of these tags can be provided. Only when at least *one* of those values overlaps with *one* the values provided here will this handler be applied. If an empty string is provided (as is the default), these values will be ignored and the handler will be applied no matter what.
        Default:
        {}

      • global

        public abstract MessageSink.Global global
        The global message sink the handler should be added to. Only set this if you want your handler to be a global handler. Defaults to "NONE" which marks it as a regular handler
        Default:
        org.portico.utils.messaging.MessageSink.Global.NONE

      • augmentable

        public abstract boolean augmentable
        Is this handler happy to be extended into a chain (defaults to true)
        Default:
        true

      • priority

        public abstract int priority
        If handler is augmented, where should it fall in the chain? (numbers between 1-10). Lower priority (lower numbers) means further back in the chain. Any number greater than 10 considered to be 10. (defaults to 5)
        Default:
        5
